question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: While

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the usage of the given words.
 
 
• "Where" is most commonly used as an adverb to define a location or position.
 
• "While" is usually used when we have two continuous actions taking place at the same time.
 
• "Why" is used at the beginning of a clause in which you talk about the reasons for something.
 
• "What" is an interrogative pronoun used to stand for something the speaker does not yet know. 
 
 
 
• *​*As per the usage of the given words "While"* *is an appropriate option to fill in the blank as **two opinions are given in the paragraph -** **"My mother believed she should become a reporter, but my father advised she become a doctor."**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 2.

Complete Paragraph: *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) asked __us which career she should (2) __opt __for. My father suggested (3) __that __she should become a doctor, (4) **__While __**my mother said she could (5)______ a newspaper reporter. I (6) ______ she would make a (7)______ teacher. After a brief (8)______ my sister declared, “I will become (9)______ actress. Then I will get an (10)______ to play all these roles.”*
